A.name: A
A.label: Existing random/transductive split
A.description: Exact original 80/10/10 random edge split, reproduced with seed 42.

B.name: B
B.label: Reverse-edge-aware split
B.description: Reverse-direction edges are grouped and assigned to the same split. No test positive has its reverse in training.

C.name: C
C.label: Edge-disjoint reverse control on the original split
C.description: Original split and original evaluation positives, but training edges whose reverse is a validation/test positive are excluded from message passing and optimization.

reverse_control.rule: Remove a training edge when its reverse is a validation or test positive.

D.name: D
D.label: Temporal evaluation (IC-SPLC only)
D.description: Chronological IC-SPLC split: train <=2023, validation 2024, test 2025. Reverse counterparts of validation/test positives are removed from training.

reverse_control.rule: Remove a training edge when its reverse is a validation or test positive.

temporal.reason_for_source_limit: AnonNet has no edge years. SAMPOQ years are filing-derived and 92% of its edges are from 2026, so a pooled temporal split is not scientifically comparable across sources.

split_reproduction.note: The original random edge split is reproducible with seed 42 on edge_index.csv ordering.

notes: The current 136-dimensional model input is 8 static flags plus 128 IC-SPLC embedding dimensions.
Full-graph structural features are excluded from every Phase 2 model.
Structural ablation features are recomputed from each protocol training graph only.
Categorical features use source-specific embedding tables; anonymized codes are not reverse-mapped.
Edge features are audited but not used in configs 1-5; config 6 is not implemented.

test_calibration_raw.clipping: probabilities clipped to [1e-15, 1-1e-15] for log loss

original_artifact.note: Reported original metrics use the original negative-sample realization; they are not directly pair-identical to Phase 2 Protocol A.

limitations: Protocol A uses the original random split; exact negative pairs are regenerated with a fixed seed, so they are not identical to the original negative realization.
Protocol B groups reverse pairs and may change source-specific test counts slightly.
Protocol C keeps the original evaluation pairs and removes reverse-of-evaluation edges from training, isolating reverse leakage.
Protocol D covers IC-SPLC only because AnonNet has no edge years and a pooled temporal split is not comparable.
Config 6 edge-aware modeling is not implemented; edge features are audited only.
Test sets are balanced 50/50, so precision and AP are not production prevalence estimates.
No verified company-level risk labels exist; this is link prediction, not disruption-risk prediction.
No cross-source entity resolution exists; the three source graphs are disconnected.
Component and degree features are transductive and not valid for entirely unseen nodes.
